# Retirement: Always Encrypted with Intel SGX Enclaves

## What Changed

Always Encrypted with Intel SGX enclaves in Azure SQL Database will retire on October 31, 2027 as support for SGX-enabled DC-series hardware is phased out. Customers should transition to Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) enclaves, a hardware-independent

## Why It Matters to a CSA

This can create a customer delivery blocker or migration requirement.
